provenance.evidence: ROM scene 5 record 50 at 0x067C5E publishes event 4. Although event-table row 4 at 0x0679CA is 0x23, ROM 0x1FA78 intercepts scene 5/event 4, selects mode profile 0x1220A8, menu mode 6/result 2, and the MicroTronics prompt at 0x110EBA. Default result calls 0x56AC0; signed alternate results play the package record and return without opening the service.
